# SunPump Source Snapshot

This directory records the provenance of the SunPump official public token list collected on 2026 08 11.

The raw snapshot contains 1,000 unique token contract addresses. The API returned no rows after twenty pages of 50 rows. This is a metadata validation snapshot, not full TRON launch coverage.

Raw records are stored under `snapshot/` and excluded from Git. `SOURCE.json` records the exact request contract, row count, limitation, and SHA256 digest.

No decoded swaps are collected for this source.
